references.text: The prohibition against uncovering one's uncle's nakedness by approaching his wife is the basis for the punishment described in Leviticus 20:20.
A parallel law concerning uncovering the nakedness of close relatives, with a similar penalty of bearing one's sin.
The next verse in the same legal collection also deals with forbidden sexual relations with relatives and the penalty of childlessness.
A curse pronounced against anyone who lies with his father's wife, which is part of the same category of sexual sins.
Ezekiel condemns sexual immorality with close relatives as one of Jerusalem's abominations.
